name: Salmon salad
summary: Gỏi cá hồi is the salmon salad named at the falls restaurant. One provincial listing also prints it at 300,000 đồng at Anh Dũng, beside an average of 1,000,000 đồng.
origin: Named at nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa on the falls page, and on the national Sa Pa food list.
howToEat: As a salad. A dressing was not printed on the falls page. Check on arrival.
At Anh Dũng the same name is printed at 300,000 đồng. That listing’s introduction says the menu does not print a per-dish price, and the average is 1,000,000 đồng. Both figures stay.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa, near the falls gate. Anh Dũng, 06 Xuân Viên, also prints the dish.
seoTitle: Salmon salad in Sapa — falls gate and Anh Dung
seoDescription: Gỏi cá hồi at the Thác Bạc restaurant. Anh Dũng prints 300,000 đồng and an average of 1,000,000 đồng. Both stay.
